name: הגיזרה 💥

api.olderParam: offset=<oldest id seen> (exclusive: returns ids < offset, newest first)

shape.time: timestamp (ISO-8601 UTC, up to ns precision, e.g. 2026-11-11T10:14:33.947568669Z)
shape.media: text is markdown. Media are inline links: [image-embedded#](URL#WxH) (also seen with leading '!' and with a trailing ':' after WxH, e.g. #800x533:), [video-embedded#](URL[#WxH]), [audio-embedded#](URL), [quote-embedded#](<quotedId>@<quoted text, may contain %29 for ')'>). The #WxH suffix is optional. URLs may be relative (/api/files/<sha1>) - prefix with the site origin. file{url,filename,filetype} exists but was empty in all samples.
shape.author: author ('Anonymous' on most channels)

adMarkers: is_ads: true (author-set flag, also used for paid fundraising/campaign posts that look like news)
breaking: breakingId > 0 on a message = it is in the breaking strip (value = breaking item id). Separate endpoint GET /api/breaking -> {color, items:[{id, messageId, title, text, imageUrl, redirectId, createdAt (unix s), createdBy, messageTimestamp (unix s)}]}. Live updates via SSE GET /api/events, event 'breaking_update' with the same payload. Click: if redirectId -> open /api/r/<redirectId> in a new tab; else jumpToMessage(messageId) + navigate('/') (scrolls the chat to that message, loading it with /api/v3/messages?around=<id>&limit=N if needed). See NOTES.md.
notes: Newer API used by the site: GET /api/v3/messages?offset=0&limit=N&direction=desc -> {messages:[...], reactions:{<id>:{emoji:n}}, my_reactions:{}} (offset=<id> with direction=desc returns ids < offset; around=<id>&limit=N centres on a message). /api/messages (bare array) still works and embeds reactions per message. channel info: GET /api/channel/info and /api/channel/branding. SSE /api/events also emits 'reactions' and 'heartbeat'. Extra fields: scheduledId, silent, tags[].

name: התדר - עדכונים מסוננים מקבוצת הפרגוד

api.olderParam: before=<oldest id> (exclusive) -> {messages:[30 items, ascending], more:bool}. Newer: since=<last id>&ev=<edit cursor>. Single item: before=<id+1>&upto=<id>.

shape.container: first page: object {boot, build, fixes[], gone[], last_id, messages[200, ASCENDING by id], pair, permalinks, polls, reacts, readers, ready, total, views}; older page (before=): {messages[30], more}
shape.id: id (int); tg_id = source Telegram message id
shape.text: text (plain). With &md=<MD_V> the server also sends rich (markdown **bold**) and lead (first line/headline). original = unedited text.
shape.media: media ('image'|'video'|'audio'|null), media_url (absolute https://media.hateder.net/...), media_ar (aspect ratio), media_key. Top-level fixes[] = late-arriving media for ids already sent.
shape.other: kind ('news' only seen; client also knows 'summary'), pinned, poll, reply_to, edited, rewritten, reacts{counts,mine}, views, source

adMarkers: none inside messages: ads are separate HTML slots from easy-click.online ads.js (sidebar/header), reported via /api/adseen and /api/adclick. Feed JSON is clean.
notes: NOT the chat platform: a server-rendered Flask-like site. /pargod/api/messages is 404; the real path is /api/messages?source=<slug>. md param value is the page's MD_V constant (68a154a47d at time of writing; it changes with site builds - read it from the HTML 'var MD_V = "..."' if rich text is needed; without md you get plain text only). limit param is ignored. Responses are edge-cached (s-maxage=5). Text often starts with 'הפרגוד: ' prefix. Content: Haredi general news filtered from the 'Pargod' WhatsApp group.

name: מוזיקה אקספרס

api.olderParam: same as other 'chatfree' channels

steps: All /api/* (messages, breaking, user-info) answer 401 'User not authenticated' without a session.
There is NO guest/anonymous login endpoint in the bundle. The only auth endpoints are /auth/google, /auth/login, /auth/logout.
GET /auth/google -> {googleOauthUrl, googleOauthScope (email+profile), googleClientId}.
Browser goes to Google OAuth with redirect_uri=<origin>/login; Google returns ?code=...
App POSTs /auth/login {code} -> server sets its session cookie (name not observed: we did not log in).
Only route for a reader: a real user signs in with Google once in a browser and the proxy reuses that session cookie. Not done here (no logins allowed).

shape.time: date (ISO local Israel time without zone, e.g. 2026-11-11T12:25:05)
shape.media: type: 1=text, 2=image, 3=video. image = numeric picture id -> https://kcm.fm/upload/pictures/<floor(id/1000)>/<id>.jpg (served as webp/png). video = HLS URL https://media.kcm.fm/hls/.../master.m3u8; w/h = dimensions; iframe (embed) may appear
shape.author: user_name, user_image (picture id, same URL rule), from (writer id)
shape.section: feed (id into feeds[]: 1 אונליין, 7 כלכלה, 4 מיוזיק, 2 חרדים, 3 תורה, 5 מעניין, 10 תמונת היום, 12 רכב, 15 העדכונים, 11 הקול החדש, 14 החלאק'ס, 13 חידון ההלכה)
shape.other: rank {'1'..'4': count} = reactions (👍 כן, 👎 לא, 😄, 😢), replies (count), parent, home, visible

adMarkers: no ad flag and no ads seen in 150 feed items
page ads are injected by clicka (ultra.clicka1.co.il loader); ?native turns the ad slot off
breaking: none in the feed. Page 0 may start with an older pinned/featured item (e.g. id 78838 from Oct with home=1) - sort by date or id.
notes: Nuxt site; the route /online/:feed loads CF4J4RML.js which calls /Online/Feed/<feed>?item=&page=&user=&_live=. Likes: POST /Online/Like (not needed). Live push uses a WebSocket hub (not needed - poll Feed/0). Mixed content: news desk + music + economy + Torah sections.

name: המחדש - מבזקים

api.olderParam: page=<n> (X-WP-TotalPages header; Link rel=next) or before=<ISO date> for stable paging

shape.text: title.rendered (the whole flash text, HTML entities like " and WhatsApp-style *bold*); content.rendered is usually empty
shape.media: acf.image / acf.video. With acf_format=standard they are objects {url, mime_type, width, height, ...}; without it they are media ids (resolve via /wp-json/wp/v2/media?include=<ids>&_fields=id,source_url,mime_type). acf.video-slider, acf.add_video, acf.hide_image also exist. featured_media always 0.
shape.author: acf.change_author_name ('מערכת המחדש' = editorial)

adMarkers: acf.change_author_name == 'המחדש חדשות' -> sponsored (6 of 100 sampled: investment ads, loans, fundraising campaigns); editorial items use 'מערכת המחדש'
text pattern: many lines wrapped in *...* with 👈/✅ bullets and a call-to-action (הירשמו / לפתיחה / 📲)
notes: X-WP-Total ~70k. The site's own infinite scroll uses admin-ajax.php action=hm_load_nf_archive with a nonce and returns HTML - the REST route is cleaner. /wp-json/news_flash/v1 is only an add (POST) route. App routes /wp-json/app/v1/newsletter-news-flash exist too (not needed).
